from scipy.optimize import least_squares
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
def base(p): return p[0]*t + p[1]/(1+p[2]*x)/v + p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*x**2)
fams={
 'c*t^a*v^b': lambda p: p[5]*np.abs(t)**p[6]*np.abs(v)**p[7],
 'c*t*exp(b*v)': lambda p: p[5]*t*np.exp(p[6]*v),
 'c*t*v^b*exp(d*v)': lambda p: p[5]*t*np.abs(v)**p[6]*np.exp(p[7]*v),
 'c*t^a*exp(b*v)': lambda p: p[5]*np.abs(t)**p[6]*np.exp(p[7]*v),
 'c*t*sin(b*v)': lambda p: p[5]*t*np.sin(p[6]*v),
 'c*t*v^b*x^d': lambda p: p[5]*t*np.abs(v)**p[6]*np.abs(x)**p[7],
 'c*t*v^b/(1+d*x)': lambda p: p[5]*t*np.abs(v)**p[6]/(1+p[7]*x),
}
for name,fz in fams.items():
    def mm(p): return base(p)+fz(p)
    r=min([least_squares(lambda p: mm(p)-dv_dt, np.random.RandomState(s).uniform(0.2,2,8)) for s in range(12)], key=lambda r:r.cost)
    print(name, float(np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(dv_dt)), np.round(r.x,4))
